init.name: wait-for-db
command: until pg_isready -h db -U app; do sleep 2; done

init.name: prepare-state
command: set -eu; umask 077; for d in /state/data /state/keys /run/credentials/worker; do mkdir -p $d; chmod 0700 $d; chmod g-s $d; done
